name: The Last Dictator
detailed_description:
For years, the country has suffered under the iron fist of a ruthless dictator. Hope is suppressed, the people live in fear, and every day the regime grows stronger. Censorship, violence, poverty, and oppression define daily life. But now, resistance is rising.

You and your five comrades form a team determined to bring down the totalitarian regime. This is not just a battle—it’s a story of rebellion and the fight for freedom.

Each player in this 6-person co-op game takes on a critical role: distributing propaganda to awaken the people, gathering weapons and supplies from underground sources, launching sabotage operations, organizing the public, and igniting the flames of revolution. Earn money through missions to purchase weapons, armor, and tactical gear as you confront heavily armed police forces throughout the city.

The regime won't make it easy. Surveillance is everywhere. Streets are locked down, cities are filled with cameras, and every step forward makes the system more aggressive. But together, you are strong. Teamwork, strategic planning, and bravery will be your keys to victory.

The final mission: infiltrate the dictator's grand palace—built on the suffering of millions—and end his reign once and for all. His last breath will mark the first breath of a free people.

“Dictators fear the people. Now it's the people’s turn.”
